title: Q-REPOS-ADMIN-APPLY: archive the retired repositories through a server-side admin route
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** an admin credential bound to the org-settings workflow (one-click consent link, CONNECT-LINK-1)
**Status:** closed
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/auth/archive.js::archiveDue

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=scripts/apply_github_settings.sh
code-anchor: Q-REPOS-ADMIN-APPLY

Retired repositories (`seed`, `license`, then `workers` and `spec` after their merges) must be archived. Surfaces tested 2026-11-17: gh PATCH from a cloud session returned 403 'Repository settings writes are not permitted through this proxy'; the GitHub MCP tools expose no repository-settings call; the owner's device bridge was not connected. Route: org-settings workflow with an admin credential obtained by consent, then archive every repository whose brand.json status is retired.

Archive step wired 2026-11-17 (the item closes when the four repositories show archived after the owner click): finishing /connect/github-admin installs the administration-only app and `archiveRetired` (seed/worker/src/auth/archive.js) archives every retired repository in one pass; failures are recorded and retried.
Resolver: `archiveDue` runs on every credentials tick for each tenant with the admin app installed and retries until the `archived` credential event exists.
